what: success and frame health per robot per day

docs.description: Fleet health for each robot on each day: how many episodes it recorded, how many succeeded, and how healthy its frames were.
docs.grain: one row per robot per day

columns.recorded_on: The day, in UTC, on which its episodes started.
columns.episodes: How many episodes the robot recorded that day.
columns.success_rate: successes divided by episodes, from 0 to 1.
columns.frames: How many frames those episodes hold.
columns.dropped_frames: How many of those frames were dropped.
columns.drop_rate: dropped_frames divided by frames, from 0 to 1.
columns.max_skew_ms: The largest gap between the RGB and depth timestamps of any of those frames, in milliseconds.
